story_type: crew abandons a sinking ship into the Bering Sea, helicopter hoists to a cutter in heavy seas
hook: 47 people went into the Bering Sea in survival suits.
narration: Forty seven people abandoned a sinking fishing ship in the Bering Sea, straight into the water.
The Alaska Ranger radioed for help at two fifty two in the morning, a hundred and twenty miles west of Dutch Harbor.
When the first rescue helicopter arrived two and a half hours later, the ship had already sunk.
Every one of them wore a survival suit. It is sealed and insulated, so it floats you and slows how fast freezing water steals your body heat.
Through high winds, heavy seas and ice, helicopter crews lowered survivors to the pitching deck of the cutter Munro.
outcome: Forty two of the Alaska Ranger's forty seven crew members survived.
title: 47 into the Bering Sea, 42 survived
description:
On March 23, 2008, the fishing vessel Alaska Ranger sank about 120 miles west of Dutch Harbor, Alaska. Coast Guard helicopter and cutter crews worked in high winds and heavy seas, and 42 of the 47 crew members survived.

Footage: U.S. Coast Guard video, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/313238/alaska-ranger-rescue

extra_sources.excerpt: Senator Lisa Murkowski late Monday commended the brave actions of the men and women of the United States Coast Guard who participated in efforts to rescue the 47-member crew of the fishing vessel Alaska Ranger. As a result of their heroic efforts, 42 members of the Ranger's crew survived. Every member of the crew was wearing a survival suit. The Alaska Ranger first radioed a distress call to the Coast Guard Communications Station in Kodiak at 2:52 a.m. on Sunday, March 23rd. The vessel was 120 miles west of Dutch Harbor. When the first rescue helicopter arrived on the scene two and one half hours later, the Alaska Ranger had already sunk. The Coast Guard faced high winds, seas, darkness, ice, and freezing temperatures

BERING SEA (March 23, 2008) Imagery of the Alaska Ranger rescue from the Coast Guard Cutter Munro. The Alaska Ranger sank 120 miles west of Dutch Harbor March 23, 2008. Left to right: CPO Chris Martin, SN Mikki Huntington, SN Alexis Rendon, and SN Chandra Fisher providing aid to recently rescued crew members from the Alaska Ranger.
